_README: Curated allowlist for scripts/validate_docs_reality.py. Two CLI buckets: roadmap_allow (intentional forward-looking / other-product / internal-tool references — NEVER a failure) and tracked_drift (KNOWN drift in customer docs/marketing being removed/reconciled by in-flight docs PRs — non-fatal in the normal gate so a green tree stays green, but FAILS under --strict; this is the punch-list). Any `corelink <cmd>` that is neither valid, roadmap-allowed, nor tracked FAILS the gate — that is how NEW drift is caught. Shrink tracked_drift as the fix PRs land; a stale entry is harmless (it simply stops matching).

roadmap_allow.ci: Build-acceleration / CI expansion campaign #1 (post-launch phase 3) — a roadmap surface, not the launch CLI. See marketing/expansion/ci-build-acceleration.md.
roadmap_allow.lighthouse: Internal marketing 'lighthouse-kit' case-study tooling, not the customer product CLI.
roadmap_allow.kms: BYOK CMK attach — ships at GA per the BYOK roadmap (byok concept still gated-inert).
roadmap_allow.workspace: Separate CoreLink Workspaces product (corelink-workspaces / clw CLI), not this binary.
roadmap_allow.workspaces: Separate CoreLink Workspaces product (corelink-workspaces / clw CLI), not this binary.
roadmap_allow.runners: Runners metered add-on — roadmap surface, not a shipped `corelink` verb.

buck2-init.reason: Installation tutorial documents `corelink buck2-init`; absent from the CLI enum. (Sibling `bazel-init` now shipped in the CLI via #708 and auto-passes; buck2-init is still the docs-fix punch-list.)

cargo-init.reason: A comparison page documents `corelink cargo-init`; absent from the CLI enum.

cas import.reason: A migration/objection doc references `corelink cas import`; the shipped CAS actions are `export` / `get` (bulk ingest is `corelink import`, a top-level verb). Docs-fix PR reconciling the verb name.

cas put.reason: Docs/marketing reference `corelink cas put`; the shipped CAS action set is `export` / `get` and the write verb is top-level `corelink put`. Docs-fix PR reconciling the verb name.

ping.reason: Installation tutorial references `corelink ping`; the shipped health/connectivity check is `corelink doctor`.

init.reason: An onboarding step references `corelink init`; not in the CLI enum (`corelink login` is the setup verb).

gc.reason: The error taxonomy references `corelink gc`; GC is a server-side scheduled worker, there is no client verb.

billing.reason: A retention health-score doc references `corelink billing`; billing is admin/console-plane, not a CLI verb.

admin.reason: RBAC how-tos document `corelink admin {audit,members,pat}`; admin operations are console/API today, there is no shipped `admin` CLI verb.

dsr.reason: Support templates document `corelink dsr request`; DSR is an admin-plane operation, not a CLI verb.

auth.reason: A playbook documents `corelink auth login`; the shipped verb is top-level `corelink login`.

audit list.reason: Marketing/retention docs document `corelink audit list`; there is no `list` action (valid: export / tail / verify / verify-ndjson).

audit prove.reason: An audit-chain explainer documents `corelink audit prove`; proof verification is `corelink audit verify` / `verify-ndjson`.

deferred_coherence.reason: BYOK across 4 KMS providers is asserted as an AVAILABLE capability, but the OKF byok concept records the prod KmsProvider wiring as DEFERRED / still gated-inert (zero active tenants). State it as a GA/roadmap item, not present-tense available.

The CAS plane addresses + client-verifies blobs by BLAKE3 (CTRL-CAS-002; see the CLI Get/Put docstrings). A quickstart that computes the digest with `sha256sum` and uploads `sha256:<digest>` instructs users to produce a digest the server will reject. Use BLAKE3 (`corelink put` computes it).

endpoint._comment: Best-effort HTTP-path check. Unresolved paths WARN (non-fatal). Add a doc file to flagship_files to escalate its unresolved paths to a hard FAIL once its recipe is verified end-to-end. ignore_path_prefixes drops noisy non-route matches (illustrative/placeholder paths).
